svg.title: UML Diagram: Class ValueDomain in Context

g.text: UML Diagram: Class ValueDomain in Context
- The arrows of the inheritance tree are

a.title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.
a.xlink:title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.

a.title: • LabelForDisplay: A structured display label. Label provides display content of a fully human readable display for the identification of the object.
a.xlink:title: • LabelForDisplay: A structured display label. Label provides display content of a fully human readable display for the identification of the object.

a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. Provide as many of the iden ...
a.xlink:title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. Provide as many of the iden ...

a.title: • DimensionComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a dimensional data structure to identify the universes associated with data points. The variable acts as a field in the compound identifier (the key structure) to disambiguate the cells in the multi-dimensional "cube".
a.xlink:title: • DimensionComponent: Role given to a represented variable in the context of a dimensional data structure to identify the universes associated with data points. The variable acts as a field in the compound identifier (the key structure) to disambiguate the cells in the multi-dimensional "cube".

a.title: • InstanceValue: Single data instance corresponding to a concept (with a notion of equality defined) being observed, captured, or derived.
a.xlink:title: • InstanceValue: Single data instance corresponding to a concept (with a notion of equality defined) being observed, captured, or derived.

a.title: • ReferenceValueDomain: Set of permissible values for a variable playing the role of a variable value component.
a.xlink:title: • ReferenceValueDomain: Set of permissible values for a variable playing the role of a variable value component.

a.title: • SubstantiveValueDomain: Value domain for a substantive conceptual domain. Typically a description and/or enumeration of allowed values of interest.
a.xlink:title: • SubstantiveValueDomain: Value domain for a substantive conceptual domain. Typically a description and/or enumeration of allowed values of interest.

a.title: • DescriptorValueDomain: Set of permissible values for a variable playing the role of a variable descriptor component.
a.xlink:title: • DescriptorValueDomain: Set of permissible values for a variable playing the role of a variable descriptor component.

a.title: • SentinelValueDomain: Value domain for a sentinel conceptual domain.
a.xlink:title: • SentinelValueDomain: Value domain for a sentinel conceptual domain.
